directive: Directive (EU) 2023/2225 on credit agreements for consumers

rules.msg: Pay-later offer with no Article 8 warning. The advertisement must carry the words "Caution! Borrowing money costs money."
No annual percentage rate (APR) on a credit offer. Article 8 standard information must state the APR.
No representative example. Article 8 requires the standard information to be given by means of a representative example.
No total amount payable by the consumer next to the instalment figure.
No route to the Standard European Consumer Credit Information form before the consumer is bound.
No borrowing rate, fixed or variable, in the credit block.
No duration of the credit agreement stated with the offer.
The creditor or credit intermediary behind the pay-later button is not named.
Deferred payment shown without the cash price of the goods or service.
The 14-day right of withdrawal from the credit agreement is never mentioned.
Nothing tells the consumer a creditworthiness assessment will be carried out.
Citation of the repealed Directive 2008/48/EC. From 20 November 2026 the governing text is Directive (EU) 2023/2225.
Relies on the old 200-euro lower limit. CCD2 drops it: small deferred payments are in scope.

rules.pattern: (unregulated|not regulated|no regulation|exempt from|outside the scope of|falls outside)[^<\n]{0,60}(credit|CCD|consumer credit|lending)|interest[- ]free[^<\n]{0,40}(unregulated|not regulated|exempt)
rules.msg: Claims the offer sits outside consumer credit rules. Interest-free and charge-free deferred payment is inside CCD2 scope.

rules.pattern: no credit check|guaranteed approval|everyone is approved|approval guaranteed|without any checks
rules.msg: Advertises credit with no assessment. The creditworthiness assessment is mandatory under CCD2.
The credit option is pre-selected for the consumer. Credit must be a deliberate choice, not the default.

rules.pattern: (display\s*:\s*none|visibility\s*:\s*hidden|aria-hidden=["']true["']|\bhidden\b)[^\n]{0,120}(Caution!|Borrowing money costs money|representative example|\bAPR\b)|(Caution!|Borrowing money costs money|representative example|\bAPR\b)[^\n]{0,120}(display\s*:\s*none|visibility\s*:\s*hidden|aria-hidden=["']true["']|\bhidden\b)
rules.msg: Standard information is hidden from view. Article 8 requires it in a clear, concise and prominent way.
Standard information set in small print. Prominence is part of the Article 8 duty, not a styling choice.

rules.pattern: (terms (and conditions )?apply|t&cs? apply|t&cs? apply|see terms for details)\s*(<[^>]*>\s*)*$
rules.msg: The credit terms hide behind a bare "terms apply" line. The standard information belongs beside the offer.
Pushes pre-approved credit the consumer never asked for. CCD2 prohibits non-solicited credit sales.
A personalised credit offer must tell the consumer it was built by automated processing of their data.
An add-on is tied to the credit. Article 14 prohibits tying practices; bundling must stay optional.
